title: View tab
description: One tab in a <vsc-view-tabs> bar: a panel-style composite bar item (`li.action-item > a.action-label`, hidden badge and `.active-item-indicator`). The active tab gets the modern-ui pill background; inactive tabs use panelTitle.inactiveForeground and show the hover pill. Optional plain-text count after the label.
usage: Only as a child of <vsc-view-tabs>. Give each a value and its label as text; add count="6" for a plain count. Don't set checked yourself; set active on the bar.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Stable id reported by the bar's change event and matched by its active attribute

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Tab text (defaults to the element's text)

attributes.name: count
attributes.description: Optional count shown after the label as plain secondary text

attributes.name: checked
attributes.description: Active tab (set by <vsc-view-tabs> from its active attribute)
